name: popsicle
headline: WordPress Automation Tool: AI Content Generation
short_description: An advanced Python automation tool for creating and publishing high-quality content to WordPress websites using OpenAI GPT, Unsplash images, and YouTube integration. This tool generates SEO-optimized articles with rich media content while maintaining posting intervals of 14 minutes.
author: fxinfo24

sections.overview:
WordPress Automation Tool is a Python-based solution that automates content creation and publishing to WordPress websites. It uses OpenAI GPT models to generate SEO-optimized articles with customizable word counts (default 3200 words), automatically sourcing images from Unsplash and embedding YouTube videos. The tool handles keyword integration, category and tag management, and post scheduling while maintaining consistent 14-minute posting intervals. It supports bulk content processing from CSV/Excel files and includes comprehensive logging and error handling with automatic API retries and rate limiting protection.
Automate multi-topic blog content generation with SEO optimization
Bulk publish WordPress articles from CSV topic lists with media enrichment
Schedule consistent content posting at 14-minute intervals across categories
Generate plagiarism-free articles with embedded YouTube videos and featured images
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/fxinfo24/wp-automation-tool`
sections.usage:
```
Create a 1,000-word blog post for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] industry. The post should be titled '[BLOG_TITLE]'. Include 3-5 relevant images from Unsplash and embed a YouTube video about [TOPIC]. Ensure the content is SEO-optimized with relevant keywords and meta descriptions. Schedule the post to publish in 14 minutes.
```
